description: This source file provides Unicode to OEM code (CP932, Japanese Shift-JIS) conversion functions, including a mapping table for Unicode to Shift-JIS characters. The file appears to handle character encoding conversions typically used in Japanese language processing within firmware.

methods.name: ff_convert
methods.description: Converts a character between Unicode and OEM code page depending on the direction specified (Unicode to OEMCP or OEMCP to Unicode). Uses binary search or incremental search over predefined lookup tables to find corresponding mappings.

methods.name: ff_wtoupper
methods.description: Converts a wide character to its uppercase equivalent using predefined lowercase and uppercase lookup tables. Handles various character ranges including Latin, Greek, Cyrillic, and extended Unicode characters.
